prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale delivers land/coastal/cryosphere products with predictable latency/documented quality;ground excludes spacecraft/launch/external-processing except interfaces. Mission Control Center(Bluebell) supervises/plans/releases commands;User Services Portal records request acceptance/review. Mission Planning System(Cedar) validates authority,timing,modes,geometry,resources;produces schedules,Contact booking requests→Ground Network Manager(Juniper),planning metadata→Payload Processing Facility(Forgehouse),command preparation package→Bluebell. Juniper manages contacts/maintenance;Antenna Deicing Notice→Spacecraft Operations Team. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey) independently checks commands/configuration/provenance/authority;maneuvers match screened plans;Cybersecurity Desk reviews exceptions;Bluebell+Operations concurrence precedes queueing. Telemetry Ingest Service validates frames/files/manifests,isolates defects,creates immutable staging/session identifiers,state checks,Pass Replay Packet. Network Control System(Lantern) manages circuits/routes/readiness;Security Exception Ticket restricts affected transfers until containment completes;shall preserve validated routing/reject unreviewed changes during transfers. North S-Band Antenna/South S-Band Antenna command/telemetry;Kiruna X-Band Antenna/Svalbard X-Band Antenna additionally track. Orbit Determination Engine→states,predictions,Doppler Residual Report,Laser Retroreflector Window. Flight Dynamics Team validates tracking→Flight Dynamics Facility(Mistral);ephemerides/events→Bluebell/Cedar/Forgehouse;Ephemeris Delta Note flags threshold changes;Payload Calibration Team receives geometry. Every processing level records software-build/calibration-baseline/ancillary versions for auditable regeneration. Payload Calibration Team approves baselines after trend review;changes undergo recent-scene comparison;changed radiometry/alignment/saturation requires specification updates before general release. Product Quality Service uses patch bundle for applicability checks;checks frames/covariance/time/contact;encodes missing-packet,timing,saturation,cloud,geolocation,fallback flags in metadata/summary records. Failed mandatory checks,missing ancillary data,blocking review→delivery hold;Product Hold List tracks defects;staging remains reproducible,no delivery until clearance. Scheduling service moves eligible overloaded Primary Processing Cluster jobs→Backup Processing Cluster with identical container/rules;fallback provenance informs quality. Both unavailable→suspend,preserve raw staging,notify Bluebell via operational event channel. Long Term Archive(Granite) stores released products distinguishing operational/test/reprocessed output;coordinates capacity/retrieval;sends

New part:
S176: Recovery after suspension prioritizes products with contractual latency commitments, then processes remaining scenes in acquisition order unless mission management approves a different backlog rule.
S177: Long Term Archive is the authoritative repository for Sentinel Vale raw downlink, auxiliary data, processing inputs, generated products, and operational metadata after routine production has completed.
S178: Archive admission begins only after Payload Processing Facility has delivered the product package, associated quality metadata, and checksum evidence required by the configured acceptance rule.
S179: Each accepted object is assigned a persistent identifier that remains stable across media migration, catalogue refresh, and later reprocessing campaigns.
S180: The repository stores object content separately from searchable metadata so that catalogue publication can proceed without exposing internal storage paths.
S181: Catalogue records are published to User Services Portal after Product Quality Service has set the public quality status and the embargo rule has been evaluated.
S182: Products under operational review remain discoverable only to authorized mission staff until the release condition is cleared.
S183: User Services Portal provides search, preview, order, and download functions through a browser interface and documented machine interfaces.
S184: Download services support resumable transfer, integrity verification, and rate controls that protect mission operations from excessive external demand.
S185: Registered users receive authorization scopes based on mission policy, contractual access rights, and applicable data licensing constraints.
S186: Anonymous access is allowed only for product classes that have been approved for open dissemination by mission management.
S187: Long Term Archive retains raw acquisition data for the life of the mission and for the post-mission preservation period defined in the archive policy.
S188: Standard Level 1 and Level 2 products are retained online while demand, contractual latency, or reprocessing dependence justifies low-latency access.
S189: Older product copies may be moved to lower-cost storage when catalogue metadata, checksums, and restore procedures remain available.
S190: Deletion is performed only against superseded temporary products, expired working copies, or objects covered by an approved disposal rule.
S191: Retention exceptions require traceability to the approving authority, the affected product classes, and the expected operational impact.
S192: Reprocessing is triggered when calibration improvements, processor corrections, orbit updates, or quality investigations materially change product fitness for use.
S193: Payload Calibration Team may request a reprocessing campaign when validation evidence shows a systematic radiometric or geometric issue.
S194: Mistral publishes orbit quality state changes to the archive operations queue before catalogue validity flags are updated.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
